capabilities: sync HamsterBase highlights into a vault folder
configure the HamsterBase API server entrypoint and token
choose the folder where highlights are saved
run the sync from the command palette
extras: README is brief: install steps, three settings, and one command; no explanation of how sync handles updates or duplicates. Feedback is offered in Chinese via a separate link.
problem: Highlights saved in HamsterBase have no built-in way to be brought into an Obsidian vault as notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin can only be used with the dependency on hamsterbase.

summary: Official connector that exports highlights from the HamsterBase service into a chosen vault folder via a sync command.
